# Oct 7: Designing the schematic
So I don't really have a clear idea on how I could customise my Starbie, so I'll follow the guide and hope an idea pops up eventually.

Today I started designing the schematic, and as you can see in the screenshot below, I just followed the guide. Hopefully my idea appears while I route the PCB.

![Starbie Schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/T1m3dUQIlqvah1bnERdkkL8q0tEUdK0v/5e1287a2f925a5f4bd1a2848f3b6c71f92167c7d58c2d7db46a63114071ea6ea.png)

I noticed that in the guide, the example Starbie had a Mario-style star, so I was thinking of making my Starbie shaped like a different video game object. Maybe I could do another Mario-themed item, like a mushroom, or something from a different game, like Undertale, Minecraft, or even Pikuniku.

maybe i could design my starbie character after pikuniku...

### 2026-10-11 – # Oct 11: Routing the PCB

**1.88h**

# Oct 11: Routing the PCB
The PCB itself should be ready now.

Yesterday I routed up all the components on the PCB, which took me about 15 minutes only. Most of the time spent on this log was the art and customisation.

First, I made the board shape the Totem of Undying (Minecraft item). Took me about 30 minutes outlining the item in Figma because converting the image to an SVG did not work out.

After all the routing, I added silkscreen art, and made my PCB look really cool (see images below).

![Front of PCB](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/T1m3dUQIlqvah1bnERdkkL8q0tEUdK0v/363bdc8ac469884c63c3e3762b6b8ff3e744fa8a636032f507ef71d4ab571ba9.png)

![Back of PCB](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/T1m3dUQIlqvah1bnERdkkL8q0tEUdK0v/fc7f3f3108df32c7e58434441beed5968863f132b6f07750c7b8a9c8e3160bf1.png)

Next log, I'll write up the firmware and probably customise my Starbie character to be something like Pikuniku.
